title: Nickname
summary: NICKNAME, noun [G. To banter. Signifies to surname, to call by a name of reproach.] A name given in contempt, derision or reproach; an opprobrious appellation. NICKNAME, verb transitive To give a name

inlines.v: NICKNAME, noun [G. To banter. Signifies to surname, to call by a name of reproach.] A name given in contempt, derision or reproach; an opprobrious appellation. NICKNAME, verb transitive To give a name of reproach; to call by an opprobrious appellation. You nickname virtue vice.
